 Print Cricket Australia on Wednesday has unveiled a large mural featuring Australian cricketers Travis Head and Alex Carey in Adelaide. (Cricket Australia) ADELAIDE: Cricket Australia has unveiled a large mural featuring Australian cricketers Travis Head and Alex Carey in Adelaide, marking the 50-day countdown to the much-anticipated Christmas Test. The unveiling brought together cricket personalities and members of Head's family, with his wife, Jess Head, and their children attending the event to see the mural up close for the first time. Watch Bhuvneshwar Kumar press conference: Abhishek Sharma's fearless batting, T20 mindset and more Former Australian cricketers Mel Jones and Callum Ferguson were also present at the event organised by Cricket Australia. The mural celebrates two of Australia's prominent cricketers, both of whom have strong ties to South Australian cricket. The unveiling also added to the build-up to the traditional Christmas Test, one of the highlights of Australia's home summer.
